name: io.github.ni-c/caldav-mcp
title: CalDAV calendars
description: Read and write CalDAV calendars: events, tasks and journal entries over the open standard

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_URL
environmentVariables.description: Root of the CalDAV server, e.g. https://dav.example.net. A calendar collection URL also works.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Account name. Most hosted services want an app-specific password with it.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password or app-specific password. Deleted from the environment once read.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, as an alternative to username and password. Not both.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_CALENDARS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated calendars this server may touch, by path or final path segment. Default: all of them.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA zone for timestamps that carry no offset, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default: UTC)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_USER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The address you are invited as, so respond_to_event can find your own attendee line

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_MAX_EVENTS
environmentVariables.description: Entries a listing returns by default, 1 to 500 (default: 100)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate on the configured host only (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow a plain http:// URL to a host that is not loopback, which sends the credentials unencrypted (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left

environmentVariables.name: ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: Deliberately unprefixed, and reaches every MCP server in the environment. Set to false to make guarded tools use the two-call token instead of a dialog (default: true)
